nodes.name: Get New Users By Source Medium

parameters.jsCode:
const chartMeta = $('Prepare Chart Configs').all();
const uploads = items; // this node's input = Upload Chart to Slack output, 1:1 with chartMeta by index

const permalinkByKey = {};
for (let i = 0; i < chartMeta.length; i++) {
  const key = chartMeta[i].json.key;
  const permalink = uploads[i] && uploads[i].json ? uploads[i].json.permalink : null;
  permalinkByKey[key] = permalink;
}

const stats = $('Compute GA4 Stats').first().json;
const totals = stats.totals || {};

function fmt(v) { return (v === null || v === undefined) ? '—' : v; }

const sourceRows = stats.source.map(s => `| ${s.source} | ${fmt(s.sessions)} | ${fmt(s.activeUsers)} |`).join('\n');
const newUsersSourceRows = stats.newUsersBySourceMedium.map(s => `| ${s.sourceMedium} | ${fmt(s.newUsers)} |`).join('\n');

const canvasContent = [
  '# 📊 SolveStack.AI GA4 Analytics Dashboard',
  '',
  `Report Generated: ${stats.generatedAt}`,
  '',
  '_Fully automated — runs daily at 08:00, pulls fresh GA4 data, renders charts, and republishes this canvas. No manual steps._',
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '# 🟦 Metric Definitions',
  '',
  '- **Active Users**: GA4\'s 1-day active users metric — the number of distinct users who had an engaged session at any point during the selected period, whether they were new or returning that period. Each person is counted once regardless of how many sessions they had.',
  '- **New Users**: The number of distinct users who visited for the very first time (triggered GA4\'s `first_visit`/`first_open` event) during the selected period. New Users is always a subset of Active Users for the same period — it never includes returning visitors.',
  '- **Sessions**: A group of user interactions within a given time frame — GA4 starts a new session when a user first engages, and it ends after 30 minutes of inactivity (default) or at midnight. One user can generate many sessions in a period. This is the "Sessions" total used in the Summary, the Monthly/Weekly Trend charts, Country Statistics, and Traffic Sources below.',
  '- **Pageviews**: The total number of times a page (web) or screen (app) was loaded or became visible. If one user reloads or navigates back to the same page, each instance counts separately.',
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '# 🟦 Traffic Source Definitions',
  '',
  '_Taxonomy cutover: 2026-08-20. Lifecycle emails already send with the new tagging from 2026-08-21 onward. The Newsletter and Demo Day sources below start showing tagged sessions once those next sends go out — newsletter in ~2 weeks, demo day on 2026-08-24, 2026-08-26, and 2026-08-31. Historical sessions logged before the cutover keep their old tagging and won\'t be relabeled._',
  '',
  '- **Direct**: Visitors who reached SolveStack.ai by typing the URL directly, using a bookmark, or opening a link without a detectable referral source. This typically represents returning users or users already familiar with the platform.',
  '- **Google (Organic Search)**: Visitors who discovered SolveStack.ai through Google Search results. This reflects your SEO performance and organic discoverability.',
  '- **LinkedIn**: Visitors who clicked a link to SolveStack.ai from LinkedIn posts, company pages, profiles, or messages that weren\'t run through our own campaign tagging. Measures the effectiveness of organic LinkedIn presence and community engagement.',
  '- **Lifecycle** (`utm_source=lifecycle`): Visitors who clicked a link in an automated customer/startup lifecycle email — the welcome message or a 2-week/1-month/2-month re-engagement reminder. Break down by `sessionCampaignName` to compare welcome vs. each reminder stage.',
  '- **Newsletter** (`utm_source=newsletter`): Visitors who clicked a link in the bi-weekly SolveStack.ai newsletter. `sessionCampaignName` identifies the specific issue (dated `YYYY-MM-DD`).',
  '- **Demo Day** (`utm_source=demo-day`): Visitors who clicked a link in a demo day event invitation email. `sessionCampaignName`/`utm_content` distinguishes the invite from follow-up reminder sends.',
  '- **Campaign** (`utm_source=campaign`): Visitors who clicked a link in a one-off email campaign outside the three recurring programs above — launches, promotions, win-back sends, referral asks, etc. `sessionCampaignName` identifies the specific campaign.',
  '- **Other / unlabeled sources**: Any value not covered above (an untagged share, a third-party referral, a paid channel). Check `sessionSourceMedium` in the raw GA4 data for the exact channel before treating it as noise.',
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '# Summary (Last 12 Months)',
  '',
  '| Metric | Total |',
  '|---|---|',
  `| Active Users | ${fmt(totals.totalActiveUsers)} |`,
  `| Sessions | ${fmt(totals.totalSessions)} |`,
  `| Page Views | ${fmt(totals.totalPageViews)} |`,
  `| New Users (Last 7 Days) | ${fmt(totals.totalNewUsersLast7Days)} |`,
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '# Monthly Trend (Last 12 Months)',
  '',
  `![Monthly Trend](${permalinkByKey['monthlyTrend']})`,
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '# Weekly Trend (Last 8 Weeks)',
  '',
  `![Weekly Trend](${permalinkByKey['weeklyTrend']})`,
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '# Country-Specific Statistics (Last 90 Days)',
  '',
  '_Note: this covers a rolling 90-day window — a different period than the 12-month Summary above. Showing the top 7 countries by Active Users._',
  '',
  `![Country Breakdown](${permalinkByKey['countryBreakdown']})`,
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  '# Awareness & Reach',
  '',
  '## Traffic Sources (Last 90 Days, Top 7 by Sessions)',
  '',
  '| Source | Sessions | Active Users |',
  '|---|---|---|',
  sourceRows,
  '',
  `![Traffic Source](${permalinkByKey['trafficSource']})`,
  '',
  `## New Users per Source/Medium (${stats.rangeLabel})`,
  '',
  '| Source / Medium | New Users |',
  '|---|---|',
  newUsersSourceRows,
  '',
  `![New Users by Source/Medium](${permalinkByKey['newUsersBySourceMedium']})`,
  '',
  '---',
  '',
  `## Email Campaign Performance (${stats.campaignRangeLabel})`,
  '',
  '_Active Users and Sessions driven by clicks from the Newsletter, Lifecycle, and Demo Day email campaigns — see the Newsletter / Lifecycle / Demo Day definitions above. Measured from 2026-08-20 (taxonomy cutover) onward, since sends before that date weren’t tagged this way._',
  '',
  `![Email Campaign Performance](${permalinkByKey['campaignPerformance']})`,
  ''
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { canvasContent } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { canvas_id: "<SLACK_ID>", changes: [ { operation: "replace", document_content: { type: "markdown", markdown: $json.canvasContent } } ] } }}

parameters.content:
## 3- Google Analytics Statistics (Automated)

Runs daily at 08:00. Pulls GA4 report data (monthly trend, weekly trend, country breakdown, traffic source breakdown, engaged sessions by source/medium and new users by source/medium over the last 7 days), computes stats, renders 6 chart images via QuickChart, uploads them to get permalinks, then replaces the shared GA4 Slack canvas (<SLACK_ID>) with the full report.

No email step — replaces the manual "download JSON -> email -> upload to Claude -> post to Slack" step from the original '3- Google Analytics Statistics' flow. Does NOT modify that original workflow; it stays as a manual reference.
